# [In preview] Public Preview: Central governance of hosted-agent outbound domains in Foundry Agent Service

## What Changed

Administrators can use Azure Policy to govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors configure and attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version. The egress policy then controls outbound request

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A preview can inform roadmap and technical validation, but is not a production commitment.

## Customer Impact
